title: Make the jump yours
heading: You’re the designer. Make the jump yours.
description: Change the number to choose how high your fox jumps: a whole number from 40 to 180. Press Run to see your jump. Try 40, then 180. Which feels better for your game?

scene.label: Your character in a meadow. Run your code to test the jump height.

feedback.initial: Choose a height from 40 to 180, then press Run.
feedback.success: That’s your jump design! Try another height. Which feels better for your game?
